SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
  min(valid_from) AS minvf, max(valid_to) AS maxvt, sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'members with >1 current' AS chk, count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with 0 current', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'members with >1 open-ended', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'is_current but valid_to not open', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>DATE '9999-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'open-ended but not current', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup member_key', count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null tier current', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'total distinct members', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'latest valid_from', max(CAST(valid_from AS BIGINT)) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'gold current by version-date valid today (2026-10-08)', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND valid_from<=DATE '2026-10-08' AND valid_to>=DATE '2026-10-08'
